title: Chennai fishers protest planned Secretariat-Assembly complex at Pattinapakkam
seoTitle: Chennai fishers' protest over new Secretariat

tea.why: Fishers fear the planned ₹1,200-crore complex on about 24 acres will displace them and block access to the sea.
tea.want: That the Tamil Nadu government withdraw the Secretariat-Assembly complex proposal at Pattinapakkam.
tea.changed: Sept 29: hundreds sat in protest at Srinivasapuram beach while others held a black-flag procession.

summary: Hundreds of fishers from Chennai's coastal belt, including women, protested at Srinivasapuram beach in Pattinapakkam on September 29 against the Tamil Nadu government's proposed ₹1,200-crore Secretariat and Assembly complex. They say the project, planned on over 24 acres, would displace families, cut off access to the sea and disrupt boat landing, net storage, fish drying and sales. Some protesters held a sit-in while others took out a black-flag procession, demanding that the proposal be withdrawn.
demands: Withdraw the Secretariat-Assembly complex proposal at Pattinapakkam
Protect fishing livelihoods and sea access
response: No response from the state government is reported in the sources.

updates.text: Hundreds of fishers protested at Srinivasapuram beach; a black-flag procession was held.
